terra.problem: Saying Jesus was already healing when the messengers showed up adds timing the passage does not give. It says He healed people at that very hour.
The line about priests sounding official does not make sense of why they would belong on this particular list.
Wanting to see a king squeezed into Jesus' list is a forced joke and makes Papa sound as though he wants to change the line.
Saying Jesus puts John above the list of prophets turns 'more than a prophet' into a ranking over other prophets that the verse does not state.
The passage says the people acknowledged God's justice; it does not say they welcomed His purpose for themselves.
The explanation dismisses the flute answer but never explains the actual complaint: the others did not dance or weep.
